chunks: Abu Hamzah al-Thumali narrated from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام that he said:
There is no servant who intends to rise at whatever hour he intends, and Allah, Blessed and Exalted, knows that from him, except that He appoints for him two angels who awaken him at that hour.

key_terms.يَقُومَ: to rise, especially for worship or prayer

ai.seo_question: How does Allah help a servant who sincerely intends to wake up for night prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a sincere intention to rise for worship, especially the night prayer, is known by Allah, Blessed and Exalted. When that intention is genuine, divine assistance is granted through two angels who stir the servant at the intended time.
